chunks: It is like pitch. It will fume in the belly.

key_terms.الْبُطُونِ: The bellies or stomachs, the location of this specific punishment.
key_terms.الْمُهْلِ: Pitch or molten resin, used here as a metaphor for boiling bodily fluids in hell.
key_terms.يَغْلِي: Boiling or bubbling, describing the intense heat and agitation of the fluids.

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says the disbelievers' fluids will boil like pitch in their bellies?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this vivid imagery of molten pitch (qarir) boiling in the stomachs underscores the physical manifestation of spiritual corruption, where the internal essence of the disbeliever is consumed by the very falsehood they embraced. Scholars such as Al-Tabarsi highlight this as a specific punishment for those who rejected the truth, contrasting the cooling of the faithful with the searing heat of the wicked. This description serves as a tangible reminder of the consequences of rejecting divine guidance, linking internal belief to external retribution.
